objective: Close the gap between care observation, smallest response, follow-through evidence and return without publishing private reality state.
recovered_sources: Cat Care Operating Protocol / Cat Canon: observation vs interpretation, care continuity and export gap
HOUSE OS: maintenance/care stay visible; spatial address + return condition
72-hour stabilization runbook: care before tools; proof beats discussion; preserve UNKNOWN
Dayline handoff: explicit session-only context/action transport
Shopping↔HOUSE: measured fit may inform care burden, but does not mutate HOUSE authority
HUMAN PORT / CONTACT: local editable envelope → explicit native Share/Copy → external channel; no false send claim
delta: CARE added to canonical HOUSE projection set
browser-local episode schema with address, class, observed, action, return_condition, state and receipt
OPEN/WATCH/DONE state machine; DONE requires receipt
one selected CARE episode can project into HUMAN PORT as a minimized editable PING draft
privacy: No personal care episode, recipient identity, message contents or telemetry are committed by this change.
falsifier: If ordinary use creates more logging burden than follow-through value, remove CARE as a standing projection and retain only the episode schema/export primitive.
next_test: Use one ordinary local CARE episode. If useful to another person, PORT it, edit/select what to disclose, share through the existing channel, then record only a real returned outcome/receipt in CARE.

external_world_evidence.observed: User reports sharing the care material with a family member through WhatsApp.
external_world_evidence.rule: Treat sharing as consequence evidence, not as proof of understanding or care outcome.
